title: The Forward Deployed Tester — Field Guide
eyebrow: Plate 44 · a field guide of its own
footer: The Forward Deployed Tester · code in [forward-qa-agents](https://github.com/akc031185/forward-qa-agents) · companion guides: [The SDET Architect](https://akc031185.github.io/sdet-architect/) and the [QA Agents field guide](https://akc031185.github.io/qa-agents/).
heroH1: Vendors deliver the AI. Somebody has to measure what it actually delivered.
heroLead: Point the agent at a running web app: it crawls, records what is broken, and provisions a Playwright + Playwright MCP project in one run.
That run is the surface probe of a seven-phase engagement: baseline, golden set, eval cube, cost ledger, pilot, verdict. The [process page](process.html) lays it out.
Runs to completion with no model at all; a local open-weight model only polishes text.
primerP: One folder, one CLI, a few REST routes, one `node:test` suite.
Every deliverable exists with `LLM_PROVIDER=none`: crawl, findings, generated project, report.
Findings and artifacts land in SQLite, so every number in a report traces to a run id.
The adapter only talks to a model you run yourself; public endpoints are rejected.
